name: JACKAL + THOTH
author: Khephri Labs / Anubis Quantum Cipher
description: The calculator built for AI. JACKAL is a deterministic math kernel agents call instead of guessing; every answer says what kind of answer it is: exact, bounded, checked, estimated, or refused with a reason. This Omarchy plugin is its mission control: bar pill, dropdown and cockpit with live call ledger, probes, graph deck and receipt verification.

barWidget.description: JACKAL + THOTH: session function as a glyph, calls in the last hour beside it, and a dropdown with live activity, the latest answer, the recent feed and one-key actions. Click for the dropdown, middle-click for the cockpit, right-click to probe.
